<function name="GetCursorPos" parent="input" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns the cursor's position on the screen.
<bug issue="4964">On macOS, the cursor isn't locked on the middle of the screen which causes a significant offset of the positions returned by this function.</bug>
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The cursors position on the X axis.</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number">The cursors position on the Y axis.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
